purpose: Continue raw-number accumulation for 13524-family states 89637, 69073, 60397 and 63709 while preserving the already-established Pb III physical record separately from metadata collisions.

policy.rule: Every raw occurrence is retained for collision/source-frequency analysis but has zero automatic physical-evidence weight.
policy.promotion: A metadata occurrence never upgrades an existing or new target to P1/P2; physical promotion remains a separate verified workflow.
policy.duplicates: Multiple records in the same identifier namespace are grouped for density analysis and are not independent physical evidence.

information_updates.finding: The generated target 63709 independently occurs as both a NIST mass-spectral-library identifier and a JoVE broadband-SRS article identifier; this is cross-namespace collision evidence, not physical-value evidence.
The patchouli-oil paper demonstrates a reusable NIR+chemometrics workflow: 84 samples, 1000-2500 nm spectra, PLS models, LC-MS reference measurements and reported model correlations above 0.90.
information_updates.claims_boundary: 69073 is the DOI/article identifier, not a spectral quantity.

information_updates.finding: The Au-SWNT study uses Raman spectroscopy to track metal-nanoparticle functionalization and reports enhanced Raman scattering/resonant behavior, making it useful for Worldshepherd nanomaterial characterization independent of the 60397 DOI collision.
The 1954 radioactivation study provides a historical benchmark for oxygen quantification in powdered beryllium using irradiation, chemical separation of fluorine-18 and comparison with standards.
